<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="Q1yZpUW8TlLCtZHk29gl"> <mxGraphModel dx="2943" dy="1606" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 %% 스타일 정의
 classDef phase fill:#f9f9f9,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef data fill:#e1f5fe,stroke:#0288d1,stroke-width:1px;
 classDef process fill:#fff3e0,stroke:#f57c00,stroke-width:1px;
 classDef model fill:#e8f5e9,stroke:#388e3c,stroke-width:1px;
 classDef final fill:#fce4ec,stroke:#c2185b,stroke-width:2px;

 subgraph Phase 1 [\"Phase 1: Simulation & Data Generation (시뮬레이션 및 데이터 추출)\"]
 direction TB
 CM[\"CarMaker v15.0<br/>(Weather Scenarios: Sunny, Rain, Snow, Fog)\"]:::process
 
 CM --> Cam[\"Camera RSI Sensor<br/>(Raw RGB Data)\"]:::process
 CM --> GT[\"GroundTruth Sensor<br/>(3D BBox, Pos, Yaw)\"]:::process
 
 Cam --> RSDA[\"RSDA GPU Plugin<br/>(JpegEncoder.cu)\"]:::process
 RSDA -- \"nvJPEG Encoding on GPU\" --> Img[\"📂 Images (.jpg)\"]:::data
 
 GT --> GTLW[\"GTLabelWriter.cpp\"]:::process
 GTLW -- \"3D to 2D Projection & Normalization\" --> Lbl[\"📂 YOLO Labels (.txt)\"]:::data
 end

 subgraph Phase 2 [\"Phase 2: Synchronization & Preprocessing (데이터 동기화 및 전처리)\"]
 direction TB
 Sync[\"절대시간(SimCore.Time) 기반<br/>프레임 동기화 보정\"]:::process
 
 Img --> Sync
 Lbl --> Sync
 
 Sync --> DS[\"📂 Images + 📂 Labels<br/>= Total 6,228 Dataset\"]:::data
 DS --> Split[\"Dataset Split<br/>(Train 9 : Validation 1)\"]:::process
 end

 subgraph Phase 3 [\"Phase 3: Model Fine-Tuning (모델 학습)\"]
 direction TB
 PT[\"Pre-trained YOLOv8m<br/>(yolov8m.pt)\"]:::model
 FT_Script[\"fine_tuning.py<br/>(Epoch: 100, Batch: 16, Imgsz: 1280, Patience: 20, Mosaic: Close at 10)\"]:::process
 
 Split --> FT_Script
 PT --> FT_Script
 
 FT_Script --> FinalModel[\"🚀 Fine-Tuned YOLOv8m Model\"]:::model
 end

 subgraph Phase 4 [\"Phase 4: Evaluation & Testing (성능 평가)\"]
 direction TB
 TestDS[\"Test Dataset<br/>(날씨별 각 450장 구성)\"]:::data
 Eval[\"Pre-trained vs Fine-Tuned 성능 비교<br/>(mAP, Precision, Recall)\"]:::process
 Result[\"악천후(Fog, Rain, Snow) 환경에서의<br/>객체 인식 강건성 검증 완료\"]:::final
 
 FinalModel --> Eval
 TestDS --> Eval
 Eval --> Result
 end",
 "config": null
